name: Final UX & Backup/Restore
changes: Adds a dedicated Settings > Backup & Restore experience with one-click configuration backup, password-encrypted Complete Backup, and validated transactional restore.
Complete backups use browser-side AES-256-GCM with PBKDF2-SHA-256 (600,000 iterations); the backup password never reaches the backend.
Restores Settings and Automation only, creates an automatic pre-restore safety snapshot, preserves machine-specific metadata identity, and never imports active downloads/SAB runtime/caches/logs.
Preserves v3.6.96 article-aware TV/Movie sorting, all twelve themes, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, and the Defender-clean native/update architecture.
regression_guards: Configuration Backup omits provider passwords and API keys while Complete Backup uses browser-side authenticated encryption and sends no backup password to the backend.
Restore validates schema before mutation, writes a pre-restore safety snapshot, uses Automation locks, and rolls back configuration on failure.
Portable restore excludes active downloads, SAB/Automation runtime state, caches, thumbnails, logs, diagnostics, and metadata cache state.
v3.6.96 article-aware A/An/The sorting, v3.6.95 theme/readability payloads, and Defender-clean Picker/yEnc/update architecture remain unchanged.
preserved: v3.6.96 Automation library A/An/The-aware presentation sorting.
v3.6.95 theme readability and all twelve palettes.
Newsgroup Browser, download engine, Smart Import, Automation search/grab behavior, updater ownership, Picker/yEnc and installer behavior.
